name: Party Salmon Ball
description: A classic chilled salmon and cream cheese ball coated in crunchy nuts and parsley.
recipeIngredient: 1 (16 oz) can salmon, drained and flaked

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together except for the nuts and parsley.
Shape the mixture into a ball.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours (but no longer than 4 days).
Roll the ball in a mixture of nuts and parsley to coat evenly before serving.

keywords: salmon ball, cheese ball, party dip, holiday appetizer

_similar.name: Salmon Dip
_similar.description: A quick and flavorful red salmon spread perfect for crackers or sandwiches.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp garlic powder or 1 fresh garlic clove, minced

recipeInstructions.text: Drain the salmon and remove any bones.
Use a fork to flake the salmon before adding other ingredients.
Combine the softened cream cheese with the salmon and all remaining ingredients.
Mix well and serve with crackers or as a spread.

_similar.keywords: salmon dip, salmon spread, red salmon

_similar.name: Cheese Ball
_similar.description: A classic cheese ball made with grated cheese, Cheez Whiz, and deviled ham, perfect for a quick appetizer.
recipeIngredient: Chopped pecans or parsley flakes for coating

recipeInstructions.text: Beat all ingredients in a mixer until creamed.
Form into 2 balls and wrap in Saran Wrap.
Refrigerate until firm.
Roll into chopped pecans or parsley flakes to coat.

_similar.keywords: cheese ball, party appetizer, easy snack

_similar.name: Shrimp Spread
_similar.description: A savory shrimp and cheddar cheese spread served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl.
Mash the shrimp with a fork until well blended.
Refrigerate before serving with crackers.

_similar.keywords: shrimp spread, seafood dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Artichoke Appetizer
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

_similar.keywords: artichoke appetizer, cheesy dip, party snack

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer
